title: Tintoretto's Jesus
subtitle: A Mysterious Heir and a Vanished Legacy
summary: When a long-lost relative arrives at the ancestral home of the Niyogis, secrets from decades past begin to surface, shrouded in intrigue and suspicion. As Feluda investigates, he must untangle a web of family history, missing persons, and art world mysteries. What hidden truths lie behind the enigmatic return—and what dangers await those who seek them?
